decisionRule: ACCEPT only if there are zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX findings. Both counts are zero.
discipline: Independent. Refute, do not confirm. The subject was tested against all twenty-one recorded inputs, frozen language-quality leftover-join.v4, v3, and v2, frozen sdk leftover-join.v6, both independent v4 rejection reviews, the D-056/D-113/D-165/D-184/D-206/D-267/D-271 lineage, live file-08 and COORD state, the complete v4-to-v5 semantic delta, all four finding dispositions, the exact ten-obligation partition, all protected leftovers, and every dispatched attack. The current Claude review of this v5 subject was not opened, read, or used.
summary: ACCEPT at 0 blockers, 0 MUST-FIX, and 0 SHOULD-FIX. V5 preserves language-quality leftoverDesign exactly as OBL-THRESHOLDS, OBL-MATRIX-CORPUS, and OBL-G13-RESERVED; keeps DR-118 at DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED, DR-125 OPEN, DR-107 PROPOSED-CLOSED-FOR-REVIEW, and required-now 28; keeps language-quality v3 current at draft time and historical only after this successor is recorded; keeps failed v4 unrecorded, non-current, CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED, and accurately Dual REJECT rather than Split or Dual ACCEPT; and keeps sdk v6 current for DR-125. It independently reproduces and lands both distinct v4 findings: the inherited carrier arrays are restored for CLAUDE-LQLJ-V4-SF1, while first-landing provenance is corrected to v2 for CODEX-LQLJ-V4-SF1. The older CLAUDE-LQLJ-V1-SF1 and LQLJ-V1-SF1 entries retain their three live carriers, identify v2 as the first landing and v3 as the carrier-forward artifact, and are not re-landed by v5. No satisfaction, threshold, corpus, naming, SDK-API, or implementation authority is invented.
